title: Migrating Cisco VPN Client Deployment from SCCM/GPO to Intune
hook: Retire SCCM and GPO from your Cisco VPN client deployment
problem: Many fleets still push the Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) and its VPN profile through SCCM packages and Group Policy — on-prem plumbing that breaks for remote and cloud-managed devices. This solution migrates that deployment to Microsoft Intune cleanly: re-home the client install, the VPN profile, and any certificate delivery to Intune, run both side by side during cutover, and retire the SCCM/GPO path — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the migration model (inventory the current SCCM/GPO deployment, rebuild it in Intune, coexist during cutover, retire the legacy path) and how to avoid double-deployment conflicts.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune enrollment, the Secure Client installers + VPN profile/XML, the current SCCM/GPO deployment details, certificate delivery, Entra groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to rebuild the client + VPN profile in Intune, handle coexistence with the SCCM/GPO deployment, migrate a named pilot, validate parity, cut over waves, and remove the legacy delivery.

5 PowerShell scripts — current-state discovery (SCCM/GPO VPN deployment), per-device migration validation, a migration-progress/coexistence report, safe remediation/cleanup of legacy artifacts, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates (Intune-delivered client + profile working, legacy path removed, no conflict), plus Best Practices for wave-based cutover.
short: Migrate Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) deployment from SCCM/GPO to Intune — re-home the client, VPN profile, and certs, coexist during cutover, and retire the legacy path — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Migrate Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) deployment from SCCM/GPO to Intune — re-home the client, VPN profile, and certs, coexist during cutover, and retire the legacy path — pilot-first.

bottom_line: The Cisco VPN client and profile delivered from Intune instead of SCCM/GPO — migrated wave by wave, validated for parity, and proven on a pilot before you retire the legacy path.
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (Cisco ISE / Secure Client + Intune integration; certificate/posture/network-profile work, live-access risk).

Cisco ISE and Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) console/profile-editor internals are deferred to Cisco's official documentation (no fabricated menus); the Intune, Entra, and certificate side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
